booking_dogs_offer_chk.name: booking_dogs_offer_chk
booking_dogs_offer_chk.value: "booking_dogs"."status" not in ('offered', 'pending_payment') or "booking_dogs"."offer_expires_at" is not null

booking_dogs_checkout_chk.name: booking_dogs_checkout_chk
booking_dogs_checkout_chk.value: "booking_dogs"."checked_out_at" is null or "booking_dogs"."checked_in_at" is not null

service_days_capacity_chk.name: service_days_capacity_chk
service_days_capacity_chk.value: ("service_days"."session_capacity" is null or "service_days"."session_capacity" between 0 and 200) and ("service_days"."taxi_capacity" is null or "service_days"."taxi_capacity" between 0 and 200)

checkout_attempts_target_chk.name: checkout_attempts_target_chk
checkout_attempts_target_chk.value: ("checkout_attempts"."purpose" = 'booking' and "checkout_attempts"."booking_id" is not null) or ("checkout_attempts"."purpose" = 'invoice' and "checkout_attempts"."invoice_id" is not null)

invoices_issued_fields_chk.name: invoices_issued_fields_chk
invoices_issued_fields_chk.value: "invoices"."number" is null or ("invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."issue_date" is not null and "invoices"."due_date" is not null and "invoices"."bill_to_name" is not null and "invoices"."seller_details" is not null)
